evals.prompt: Check my Gmail, show me my labels, then list the email titles in Work/Startups
evals.expected_output: Lists all Gmail labels in a numbered list, then retrieves and displays email titles (sender, subject, date) from the Work/Startups label — no body content.

assertions.text: Presents a numbered list of Gmail labels before fetching any emails
Fetches emails from the correct label (Work/Startups)
Each email entry shows sender, subject, and date
No email body content or summaries are included in the output
Results are presented as a clean numbered list
